preview.caption: Page {{page}} of {{pages}}
preview.away: The selected chunk is on page {{page}}.
preview.noPlace: This chunk was added by hand and has no place on a page.
preview.none: {{type}} files have no page preview. Chunks are shown as the text that was read from the file.

live.switchedOff: Chunk switched off. It is now listed under Off.
live.switchedOn: Chunk switched on. It is now listed under On.

notice.readOnly: You can read these chunks. Only the person who uploaded this document, the dataset's creator and the workspace owner and admins can change them.
notice.documentOff: This document is switched off for search, so none of its chunks are returned. Each chunk keeps its own setting below and returns to search when the document is switched on.
notice.parsing: This document is being parsed. Chunks appear here as they are indexed, and editing is paused until parsing ends.
notice.partial: Parsing did not finish, so this list is incomplete.

empty.heading: No chunks yet
empty.body: Parse this document to split it into searchable chunks.
empty.bodyReadOnly: This document hasn't been parsed yet. The person who uploaded it, the dataset's creator or a workspace admin can parse it.

unavailable.heading: Parsing not available yet
unavailable.body: {{type}} files can be stored and downloaded, but they can't be parsed in this release.

noMatch.heading: No chunks match
noMatch.body: Try other words, or show all chunks.

notFound.heading: Document not found
notFound.body: It may have been deleted, or it isn't shared with you.
